visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The shot opens with decorative artificial pink cherry blossom branches framing a modern restaurant interior. The camera is static, focusing on empty light wood booths. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot showing several diners at wooden tables separated by semi-transparent partitions. The lighting is bright and warm. (3) Close-ups feature a split hotpot on an induction stove, surrounded by platters of red raw meats, fresh vegetables, and raw shrimp. A hand uses a golden ladle to stir the broth. (4) A hand holds a character-themed cookie sandwich resembling Totoro against the restaurant background. Two pink takeaway cups are presented. (5) The camera pans across a refrigerated buffet area containing diverse greens, mushrooms, and fish balls. A hand uses blue tongs to pick up vegetables. (6) A self-service counter displays braised pork, rice, curry, and duck blood in golden bowls. A hand dispenses a drink from a soda machine. (7) Detailed close-ups show raw beef and pork slices being lifted with chopsticks and dipped into the bubbling hotpot broth. (8) The final shot shows the modern multi-story exterior of the building with the brand logo clearly visible under natural daylight.
